dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: Th-Then I'm definitely getting fired... No, wait, that's not the point...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: I-I'll do my best to handle any problems on the train! Um... I-I mean, I don't really know how I'd handle them yet.

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: But the important thing is to try first, right...? Baryatinsky said you have to be ready to act before you know exactly what to do...
